description: AgentMail operations with local memory, safe sends, and fleet-wide insight.

tools.name: agent_sign-up
tools.description: Create a new agent organization with an inbox and API key. This endpoint is for signing up for the first time. If you've already signed up, you're all set — just use your existing API key. A 6-digit OTP is sent to the human's email for verification. This endpoint is idempotent. Calling it again with the same `human_email` will rotate the API key and resend the OTP if expired. The returned API key has limited permissions until the organization is verified via the verify endpoint. **CLI:** ```bash agentmail agent sign-up --human-email user@example.com --username my-agent ```. Required: human_email, username. Optional: referrer, source. Returns the new TypeAgentAgentSignupResponse.

params.name: human_email
params.description: Email address of the human who owns the agent. A 6-digit OTP will be sent to this address.

params.name: referrer
params.description: The channel that drove this sign-up — where the agent or its developer discovered AgentMail (e.g. `agent.email`, a partner URL, a campaign tag). Answers 'where did this sign-up come from'. Max 2048 characters.

params.name: source
params.description: The SDK, framework, or platform issuing this sign-up (e.g. `agentmail-python`, `agentmail-cli`, `agentmail-mcp`). Identifies the caller — answers 'who is signing up'. Max 2048 characters.

params.name: username
params.description: Username for the auto-created inbox (e.g. 'my-agent' creates my-agent@agentmail.to).

tools.name: agent_verify
tools.description: Verify an agent organization using the 6-digit OTP sent to the human's email during sign-up. On success, the organization is upgraded from `agent_unverified` to `agent_verified`, the send allowlist is removed, and free plan entitlements are applied. The OTP expires after 24 hours and allows a maximum of 10 attempts. If you run into any difficulties receiving the OTP code, you can also create an account on [console.agentmail.to](https://console.agentmail.to) using the human email address you provided to verify your account. **CLI:** ```bash agentmail agent verify --otp-code 123456 ```. Required: otp_code. Returns the new TypeAgentAgentVerifyResponse.

params.name: otp_code
params.description: 6-digit verification code sent to the human's email address.

tools.name: api-keys_create
tools.description: **CLI:** ```bash agentmail api-keys create --name 'My Key' ```. Optional: name, permissions. Returns the new TypeApiKeysCreateApiKeyResponse.

params.name: permissions-message-delete
params.description: Delete messages. Also required to delete threads.

params.name: permissions-message-read
params.description: Read messages. Also required to read threads.

params.name: permissions-message-update
params.description: Update message labels. Also required to update threads.

tools.name: api-keys_create-public-key
tools.description: Register a public P-256 JWK using an existing AgentMail bearer API key with `api_key_create`. Re-registering the same JWK creates a new credential ID; it does not replace or recover an earlier credential. The private key must never be sent to AgentMail. Required: public_key. Optional: expires_at, name, scope. Returns the new TypeApiKeysPublicKeyCredential.

params.name: expires_at
params.description: Future absolute expiry. Omit to inherit the registering bearer key's expiry. A child credential cannot outlive its creator.

params.name: name
params.description: Defaults to `AgentID key {first eight fingerprint characters}`.

params.name: public-key-x
params.description: A 32-byte P-256 coordinate encoded as unpadded base64url.

params.name: public-key-y
params.description: A 32-byte P-256 coordinate encoded as unpadded base64url.

params.name: scope
params.description: Omit to inherit the registering bearer key's exact scope. An explicit scope must be the caller's scope or a live descendant.

tools.name: api-keys_delete
tools.description: **CLI:** ```bash agentmail api-keys delete --api-key-id <api_key_id> ```. Required: api_key_id. Destructive.

tools.name: api-keys_list
tools.description: **CLI:** ```bash agentmail api-keys list ```. Optional: limit, page_token, ascending. Returns array of TypeApiKeysApiKey.

tools.name: api-keys_list-public-keys
tools.description: List only public-key credentials visible to the bearer caller's scope. Bearer credentials are never returned, even though both credential types share storage and pagination indexes. Requires `api_key_read`. Optional: limit, page_token, ascending. Returns array of TypeApiKeysPublicKeyCredential.

tools.name: api-keys_revoke-all-agent-id-sign-in-keys
tools.description: Invalidate every current public-key credential in the caller's organization by advancing its AgentID key generation. The caller must be organization-scoped and either have `api_key_delete` or, for a verified self-serve agent organization, use an unrestricted unmanaged bearer credential. No request body is accepted. `Idempotency-Key` is required and must be a UUID. Reusing the same UUID returns the original permanent receipt without advancing the generation again. A new UUID performs a new generation advance. Required: Idempotency-Key.

params.name: Idempotency-Key
params.description: Required UUID identifying this revoke-all operation permanently.

tools.name: api-keys_revoke-public-key
tools.description: Permanently revoke one public-key credential. This hard-deletes the credential; repeating the request returns not found. Requires `api_key_delete`. Required: api_key_id. Destructive.

params.name: api_key_id
params.description: Public-key credential ID returned by registration.

tools.name: api-keys_update-public-key-name
tools.description: Rename the credential. All security-relevant fields are immutable. Requires `api_key_update`. Required: api_key_id, name. Returns the updated TypeApiKeysPublicKeyCredential.

params.name: api_key_id
params.description: Public-key credential ID returned by registration.

tools.name: inboxes_drafts_create
tools.description: Create a draft. Supply `in_reply_to` to create a reply draft (with `reply_all` to address the whole thread), whose recipients, subject, and threading are derived from the referenced message, or `forward_of` to create a forward draft, which derives the subject, threading, and forwarded content from the source but keeps recipients caller-supplied. **CLI:** ```bash agentmail inboxes:drafts create --inbox-id <inbox_id> --to recipient@example.com --subject 'Draft subject' --text 'Draft body' ```. Required: inbox_id. Optional: attachments, bcc, cc (plus 11 more). Returns the new TypeDraftsDraft.

params.name: bcc
params.description: Addresses of BCC recipients. In format `username@domain.com` or `Display Name <username@domain.com>`.

params.name: cc
params.description: Addresses of CC recipients. In format `username@domain.com` or `Display Name <username@domain.com>`.

params.name: in_reply_to
params.description: ID of message being replied to.

params.name: reply_all
params.description: Reply to all recipients of the original message.

params.name: reply_to
params.description: Reply-to addresses. In format `username@domain.com` or `Display Name <username@domain.com>`.

params.name: send_at
params.description: Time at which to schedule send draft.

params.name: to
params.description: Addresses of recipients. In format `username@domain.com` or `Display Name <username@domain.com>`.

Required: inbox_id, draft_id. Optional: add_attachments, add_labels, bcc (plus 9 more). Returns the updated TypeDraftsDraft.

params.description: Attachments to add to the draft.

params.name: add_labels

tools.name: inboxes_messages_batch-get
tools.description: Fetch metadata for up to 500 messages in one request. Missing or restricted IDs are silently omitted; compare `count` against `limit` to detect misses. **CLI:** ```bash agentmail inboxes:messages batch-get --inbox-id <inbox_id> --message-id <id1> --message-id <id2> ```. Required: inbox_id, message_ids. Returns array of TypeMessagesMessage.

params.name: message_ids
params.description: IDs of messages to fetch. Maximum 500 ids per request. Duplicates are rejected with a validation error. IDs not found in the inbox (including cross-inbox or permission-restricted) are silently omitted from the response; callers detect misses by comparing `count` against `limit`.

tools.name: inboxes_messages_batch-update
tools.description: Apply one label change to up to 50 messages in a single request. The same add_labels and remove_labels apply to every message id, and at least one of them must be provided. The update is atomic: either all resolved messages are updated or none are. Missing or restricted ids are silently excluded; compare `count` against `limit` to detect exclusions. **CLI:** ```bash agentmail inboxes:messages batch-update --inbox-id <inbox_id> --message-id <id1> --message-id <id2> --add-label read --remove-label unread ```. Required: inbox_id, message_ids. Optional: add_labels, remove_labels. Returns array of TypeMessagesUpdateMessageResponse.

params.name: add_labels
params.description: Label or labels to add to every message.

params.name: message_ids
params.description: IDs of messages to update. Maximum 50 ids per request. Duplicates are rejected with a validation error. IDs not found in the inbox (including cross-inbox or permission-restricted) are silently excluded from the update; callers detect exclusions by comparing `count` against `limit`.

params.name: remove_labels
params.description: Label or labels to remove from every message.

params.name: track_opens

params.name: remove_labels

tools.name: inboxes_metrics_query-events
tools.description: Counts of email events (sent, delivered, bounced, etc.) over time for the inbox. Defaults to the last 24 hours; `start` must be within the last 90 days, and a future `end` is clamped to now. Omit `period` for individual event counts, or set it to sum counts into buckets of that many seconds. **CLI:** ```bash agentmail inboxes:metrics query --inbox-id <inbox_id> ```. Required: inbox_id. Optional: event_types, start, end (plus 3 more). Returns the TypeMetricsQueryMetricsResponse.

tools.name: inboxes_metrics_query-usage
tools.description: Cumulative usage series for the inbox. Each point is the running total of the usage type at that timestamp, not the change within the bucket. Inbox-scoped queries carry `storage_bytes`, `message_count`, and `thread_count`; requested types that don't apply to the scope are ignored. Defaults to the last 24 hours; `start` must be within the last 90 days, and a future `end` is clamped to now. The range divided by `period` must not exceed 1000 buckets. Required: inbox_id. Optional: usage_types, start, end (plus 3 more). Returns the TypeMetricsQueryUsageResponse.

novel_features.name: Triage queue
novel_features.description: Rank unresolved inbound conversations across inboxes with age, direction, labels, and pending drafts.

novel_features.name: Send check
novel_features.description: Review a draft for deterministic recipient, attachment, schedule, duplicate, and idempotency risks before sending.

novel_features.name: Thread rollup
novel_features.description: Render compact conversation handoff context with participants, counts, latest direction, age, labels, and extracted reply content.

novel_features.name: Fleet health
novel_features.description: Report inbox, domain, webhook, list, metrics, API-key, pod, and organization readiness findings.

novel_features.name: Schedule audit
novel_features.description: Find scheduled drafts that are overdue, orphaned, duplicated, or missing review state.

novel_features.name: Delivery reconcile
novel_features.description: Reconcile outbound messages with status, thread placement, timestamps, and later inbound activity.
